title.narrative: Provide Technical Assistance for Govenrment of Nepal

description.narrative: This activity Provide Technical Assistance for Govenrment of Nepal is a component of Skills for Employment Programme reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £734,759. It works in the following sector(s): Vocational training, Basic life skills for adults, Facilitation of orderly, safe, regular and responsible migration and mobility, Informal/semi-formal financial intermediaries.
